notes.title: EVENT: First Month of MONSTER WAR
Update v0.7.50 [09/26/2025]
notes.notes:
[h1]MONSTER WAR v0.7.50:[/h1]

[h2]MAIN MENU[/h2]
[list]
[*] Totally new main menu.
[/list]
[h2]SETTINGS MENU[/h2]
[list]
[*] Separated settings menu by Screen, Music/SFX and UI sections.
[*] Added new settings for Screen and Music/SFX sections.
[*] Added new section named UI.
[*] Added toggles for different UI elements in the game.
[/list]
[h2]INVENTORY MENU[/h2]
[list]
[*] Newest flexible design.
[/list]
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed stamina gauge and all stamina-related in-game stats.
[*] Fixed an issue with Alchemy Center when close button could disappear.
[*] Re-designed Bestiary menu.
[*] Shadow Market got the new items: Ascension Ticket, Max Level Ticket.
[/list]
[h2]MISCELLANEOUS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some well-known bugs and issues.
[*] Made game language depend on Steam.
[*] Separated inventory items by the rarities (8 rarities, from common to eternal).
[*] Now game menus might be closed through Esc key.
[*] Some minor changes.
[/list]

Dear players! We sincerely hope you will meet this update positively. Feel free to ask if you got the questions.

notes.title: September Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear players![/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694241/77a916de01bc1f5169974d90b00bca03a4987328.png"][/img]

This month, MONSTER WAR will receive the v0.7.50 update, which will bring revolutionary innovations to the game.

We are already actively developing this update, but we want to share some details now.

[/p][olist][*][p] [b]The game will no longer have stamina gauge[/b]. Based on the feedback from our players, we made a difficult but right decision: to remove stamina system. Clicks will no longer be limited by stamina, and this will give each player a huge scope for action.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]The level system will undergo a lot of reworking[/b]. There will still be opportunities in the game to speed up gaining experience, but to gain experience, you will now need to complete a whole range of tasks related to using different game mechanics.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]The combat system will be significantly transformed[/b]: there will be more ways to deal damage besides the typical clicks.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New applications of Sapphires will be added[/b]: at the time of writing this news, the use of Sapphires is limited to two shops and the functionality of the Smithy.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]The overall gameplay experience will also be improved[/b]: tutorial section will be reworked in even more detail, and buttons will appear in different game menus that open the tutorial page associated with a specific menu.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Thank you all for your support![/b][/h3]

notes.title: About current game state...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694241/77a916de01bc1f5169974d90b00bca03a4987328.png[/img]

[h1]Dear players![/h1]

At BMBK Games, we recognize that, at the time of writing this broadcast, the state of the game raises many questions and doubts, and to some extent rejects new participants.

Next month we will release a major update that will improve the gaming experience for each player and offer a number of useful fixes in the "Tutorial" section.

Responding to negative reviews, which emphasize the weak presentation of information about the MONSTER WAR device, we want to assure players that we are always open to dialogue: send the letters to our email address, use the technical support menu inside the game, or use Telegram functionality to message our channel there.

We try not to be silent and respond to every MONSTER WAR player,
We hope that the next MONSTER WAR update will be able to satisfy your requests alot.

[h1]Thanks![/h1]

notes.title: About the dissatisfactions
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694241/300db113532df2c8f63c5c3087757d31fdb42b25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3869980/MONSTER_WAR/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]We often notice that most players are skeptical about MONSTER WAR, and we ask you to be lenient with our work.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Dear players! We understand that the discontent caused among you by our first game is not unfounded. Using 2D assets generated by artificial intelligence seems to you to be an unethical, questionable and even alienating solution from our game.[/p][p][/p][p]In this regard, we would like to announce a few details. This broadcasting is based on the reaction that we often see on news portals, Telegram channels and other media...[/p][p][b]• MONSTER WAR has been officially in development for over a year[/b]:[b] [/b]Since May 11, 2024, the game has undergone many changes in design, ideas, mechanics and systems, and now the entire BMBK Games team really likes it. This is not a game that can be made in two days at minimal cost and wickedly dumped on platforms of such a serious level as Steam.[/p][p][b]•[/b] [b]The game was, is, and will be shareware[/b]: The game's Steam page does not display the price of the game, and we are asked about its cost. Just exhale now: MONSTER WAR is a shareware clicker RPG game. This means that the game will be distributed for free, but it will include in-game payments.[/p][p][b]• Microtransactions in the game are also not an intrusive element [/b]: all the content available for purchase can be obtained gaming for free, and this is the miracle of the balance of our game. In fact, by making an effort, you can become the Number One player without spending absolutely any money, and advanced mechanics like trading with other players will even help you do this. [b]In MONSTER WAR, everyone is equal![/b][/p][p][b]• The project will be upgraded and improved to meet the expectations of our players[/b]: we want MONSTER WAR to be not just a game, but a comfortable environment for everyone, and we do everything that depends on us not to lose face in front of our audience. We really try to give experienced players a fresh look at the clicker genre, expand the scope of the genre and introduce potential new players to the genre.[/p][p][b]• At BMBK Games, we are always open to suggestions and ready to interact with the community in order to create a gaming experience worthy of each of us together[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]So, we turn to the players and ask them to be less negative about our first project, our work, which literally makes our hair fall out of our heads.[/p][p]Now, at the dawn of our powers, your support is more important than ever. [/p][p][/p][h1][b]Thanks for your understanding![/b][/h1]
